notes.title: Check out the new cyberpunk boomer shooter!
notes.notes:
Guys and gals, a new game from our publisher is here!

Beyond Sunset a cyberpunk pixel carnage by Vaporware. The game, inspired by Doom and Deus Ex, masterfully mixes frantic combat with strong RPG elements. There’s shooting, there’s puzzles, there’s swinging your katana around and a lot of immersing story to discover!

[previewyoutube=JZJ55-Il094;full][/previewyoutube]

Beyond Sunset is now out in Early Access with a 10% release discount. And if you like the genre, the release is accompanied by the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/moviegamessa/sale/RetroShooterSale]Ultimate Retro Shooter Sale[/url], where you can find more great games like this one! notes.title: Sports: Renovations – new gameplay & playtest
notes.notes:
Our publisher is showing off a new game!

Here is the first look at the gameplay from Sports: Renovations. In the video, you can see clips collected from the first few renovation levels – and some in-between footage too! Ready?

[previewyoutube=6RWEOmCzaeI;full][/previewyoutube]

And that’s not the end of the good news: soon you’ll be able to play the game yourselves! Movie Games started collecting signups for the open playtest. If you want to help them improve the full game, go to the Sports: Renovations Steam page and click the “Request Access” button.

The playtest will start soon. Every person who requested access will get the option to download and play the game. After that, we will ask you to fill in a survey – your answers will be invaluable to the progress of the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2230960/Sports_Renovations/

Let’s get signing up!

notes.title: Brewpub Simulator announced – new game coming to Steam!
notes.notes:
Quit your day job, open a bar! 

We’re celebrating International Beer Day (yes, we know it’s tomorrow) with a new game about crafting beer!

[previewyoutube=kw6uf0yrJaE;full][/previewyoutube]

Brew lagers, stouts and IPAs, and serve patrons at your own brewpub. Decorate the place, create your own brands of beer, and expand into the best joint in town. All of this in a relaxing simulator that values creativity and passion for crafting.

Wishlist the game here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1755180/Brewpub_Simulator/

[list][*]Brew your dream beer! Discover new recipes, buy ingredients and unlock more advanced equipment

[*]Play multiple minigames, including pouring beer, changing kegs, mixing ingredients, bottling beer, and more

[*]Take on daily missions to earn more money and experience[/list]

notes.title: The Steam Awards 2021 – Nominate Us!
notes.notes:
Hello there! 

This year’s [b]Steam Awards nominations[/b] have just begun, and, like so many others, we would like to ask you to nominate our game!

Just like Steam says, we’re like good parents and want all the best for our game baby, even when it’s been some time since its release. So we’d be very stoked if you nominate Orbital Racer to the [b]Labor of Love Award[/b].

You can cast your vote till December 1st. If you do so, you can receive a nice badge from Steam – visit [url=https://store.steampowered.com/steamawards/nominations]this[/url] page for more info.

notes.title: A quick hotfix (1.03)
notes.notes:
Just a quick hotfix to fix a recently discovered bug in the Career mode. 
Other changes include:
[list]
[*]you can control the ship directly with a mouse. To do this, DISABLE "mouse control" and select mouse axes in "pitch", "yaw", or "roll" windows. (click add, select mouse and then select desired axis and direction from drop-down menu)

[*]added option to invert mouse Y axis for a standard "mouse control" mode
[/list]

notes.title: A quick hotfix (1.03)
notes.notes:
Just a quick hotfix to fix a recently discovered bug in the Career mode. 
Other changes include:
[list]
[*]you can control the ship directly with a mouse. To do this, DISABLE "mouse control" and select mouse axes in "pitch", "yaw", or "roll" windows. (click add, select mouse and then select desired axis and direction from drop-down menu)

[*]added option to invert mouse Y axis for a standard "mouse control" mode
[/list]

notes.title: First patch (1.02)
notes.notes:
The first patch for Orbital Racer has just been released.
First of all, I've made a few performance tweaks, so the game should run faster on every setup.
Secondly, from now on you can enable or disable available powerups for a single race event. So if there's one particular powerup that you don't like or if you fancy racing without any powerups now you can do it.
Also, you can now play the game in Italian.

Along with the update, I've also uploaded a video of a simulation race in Champion class - just to give you guys an idea how fast some of those ships can fly.

Tip. You can toggle FPS counter by pressing Shift-F8

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3SMlWyxT4KI

A complete list of changes below:

[h1]Bugfixes:[/h1]
[list]
 [*] "Scott Manley bug" has been fixed. Now, when you stray too far from the track the autopilot will engage and bring you back, even if you're disqualified.
 [*] in control options, drop-down lists will now properly disappear when at the same time a button/axis has been assigned
 [*] a scroll-down list will no longer extend beyond the screen boundaries with resolutions greater than 1080p
 [*] ixed instructor subtitles in Lesson 1 of Simulation tutorial
 [*] fixed bug in Career mode that allowed you to join a competition after the first race has finished. From now you can only join championships before the first race takes place
 [*] fixed the default race start time for the amateur track on Saturn
 [*] fixed message popup window in Career mode
[/list]
[h1]New features:[/h1]
[list]
 [*] added options to switch individual powerups in Single Race
 [*] added the Italian language
[/list]
[h1]Other:[/h1]
[list]
 [*] general performance tweaks
[/list]
